reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: Twice in the last month they unexpectedly just before flight change time of the flight both time 3 hours ahead which meaning if using for a connecting flight is useless no customer service staff rude unhelpful takes a least a month to get ur money back both times had to find another flight and mess around won't be using again got to be the worst airline company out there. Planes are in terrible condition looks like something from the 1960s inside absolutely disgusting wouldn't recommend stay clear from this company if I could swear on here would be many more things I could say
reviews.author: Daniel H

reviews.title: Never in my life will i use this airline again
reviews.text: So i booked a ticket from the airline in which i pay 12,000 rubles for a 1 hour 30 minute flight because my baggage was 500 gram more than 23kg,they are thieves,anyway because of the traffic in saint petersburg that i didnt expect i got to the airport exactly 50 minutes before,while driving i called them multiple times to modify my flight before the flight check in ends,the same woman end the call on me very rudely, when i tried to check in the lady said i was late,actuallt i wasn’t because i was tracking the flight on my way phone ans till had 45 minutes,so they told me to go modify the fligjt and the ladies were very very extremely rude and said i should pay 5300 more rubles and them again plus 3000 making it 8300 plus the 12k i previously paid,so they booked the next flight and i only had 15 minutes to check in and they allowe it but didnt allow when i came 45 minutes before my flight,i dont mind about the money but the lady who was rebooking my ticket was extremely rude and why is Russia still living in 1950 where a well known and used airport the workers dont know any english and even so they start shouting in Russian and insulting without knowing that I understand the language,never in my life will i use it,please avoid this airline.i spent 20,300 rubles for 1 hour 30 minutes flight.thieves.
reviews.author: Shane M

reviews.title: Ural Airlines, definitely would recommend again!
reviews.text: I was flying comfort class ( business class seats service economy) even tho it was Covid the crew gave out hot food I ordered Asian food and it was delicious. Crew was nice we upgraded from economy to comfort which was 3000₽. Definitely would fly again.
reviews.author: Phillip Chigrin

reviews.title: Worst airlines ever
reviews.text: The airline has lots of hidden fees, especially when you cancel or change the date. Customer service is horrible 👎
reviews.author: Khayom

reviews.title: The worst airlines ever! Frauds! Stay away!
reviews.text: They are the worst, stay as far as possible from them. Not only they cancel flights without even letting passengers know, but they don't make a refund. They've been ignoring and avoiding my messages for almost 3 months. The only replies i got were: we can't process your request without a ticket number" (and the tickets were never sent!) or "be patient, we are loaded with the requests". Choose any other company. Because if you deal with Ural airlines you might not see your tickets and money and will still have to get another tickets what has happened to many people and our family.
reviews.author: Yuliya S

reviews.title: The worst airline I’ve ever encountered
reviews.text: Of the 3 flights I took with Ural, all 3 were at least 1 hour late. Their checkin process is completely broken as well, with online check-in not working and 50 minutes lines at the airport. They never offered an apology for any of the delays. I’d rather pay twice next time just to avoid flying with them.
reviews.author: Dimitry

reviews.title: Will do everything to avoid it. Not for foreigners!
reviews.text: So... Ural let me enter the flight but i never could enter the RUssian Federation due to a luck of documents, as they told me. The airline representative appears after 20 hours, and there are no way you can call their call center from a foreign number. He appears just to let me know they could help me only in a few days, means I need to sleep on the bench there a few days. So I brought the additional tickets for 2 more flights (appears this airport is mostly for a local flights), a hotel in a 3rd country, a new PCR test, etc. Unbelievable experience. Better avoid this company if you don't have RU citizenship. At least until Covid shield is down. Of course I tried to contact them later on. Got a feedback in Russian only, no way to get anything else.
reviews.author: unnecessary

reviews.title: All flights are delayed with no reason
reviews.text: Had a round trip with them, 4 flights in total. Every single one of them got delayed, except the last one - it wasn’t, so we had to wait for a new flight for 24 hours because we missed transfer due to delay. Gave us food stamps for 400 RUB per person, which would get you probably one sandwich in the airport. Booked cheapest rooms in nearby hostel, that don’t include such luxury as single-use toothbrush and paste 😂 Gotta give it to them though, at least we had rooms. The new flight also got delayed. It’s also fun that they don’t announce delays, you must spot them on display or you’re screwed. Awful experience, more then 30 hours just wasted!
reviews.author: Alexander Anikeev

reviews.title: total mess and disaster
reviews.text: First they send me an email that my flight is cancelled from Dubai to Krasnoyarsk. Then they send me another email that my return flight Krasnoyarsk - Ekaterinburg - Dubai is now changed to Krasnoyarsk - Ekaterinburg - Ufa - Dubai. However i notice a small issue.... a very small unimportant detail!!!! My flight from Ekaterinburg to Ufa takes off 2 hours before my landing to Ekaterinburg from Krasnoyarsk!! What is this??? Who are the brainless people who prepared this email and sent it to all passengers!??! IT gets worse as I paid via online travel agency. Another bunch of retards - Smart Fares. According to them, since the flight from Krasnoyarsk to Ekaterinburg was not cancelled, they will not refund me the full ticket amount. But AS A GOODWILL GESTURE, they will refund me half. They couldnt care less that I cant make it to my final destination no matter what because the stupid Ural airlines sent the above nonsense to all their passengers and partners: fly with 2 stopovers, yes you won't be able to catch the flights, but they are NOT cancelled. Are you totally out of your mind Ural airlines??? Or are you robbing the people together with Smart Fares and other members of your gang??
reviews.author: Sabrina

reviews.title: Always delay on their flight
reviews.text: The flight delayed for more than 9 hours without any excuses Passengers started shouting and the ground staff and they were so mad about the service They serve just water on the flight !
reviews.author: Khalid Alrazooqi

reviews.title: Money not refunded yet
reviews.text: It’s been two months since requested for refund as passenger was tested positive before flight. Request to refund money.
reviews.author: Goravv

reviews.title: No Ticket Refund
reviews.text: I had to cancel my ticket, and order a new one so I could add my 4 year old son. Before cancelling, I checked company website to see if I will be able to get refund, which said I can. I tried calling Ural Airlines Offices to reconfirm (Moscow, Ekaterinburg) but no one is picking up the phone. Long story short, cancelled the ticket (May-21) when arrived to Dubai, called their Office, surprisingly they answered the phone, checked the system and said my ticket status is mentioned as "refund approved", so agent said I need to follow up with my bank (which is complete nonsense), as no attempt to transfer my amount was ever made. Now, more than 2 months passed, still havent received any response from them. I am planning to complain to DED, let them close their office in Dubai, if they want to behave like thieves.
reviews.author: Snow C

reviews.title: Never ever will use Ural again!!!
reviews.text: Flew from Kyrgyzstan to Moscow to fly to London. Transit through Russia. Crew couldn’t accept Visa Debit card and I couldn’t buy a beer and soft drinks for kids. Literally had to take it from kids hands and give it back to the rude stewardesses. Staff kept eyeballing the passengers and were quite rude. One of them just sat at the back and was watching movies on her iPad .With headphones on . Couldn’t believe it! Sandwich was just a bread with slice of cucumber and paper thin meat some sort of. Most of the passengers were immigrant workers who went to Moscow for work I guess. But you can’t treat people like second class of people and blatantly be rude. Zhukovo airport was very small and shabby. And passport control staff were even more rude. Felt like I was in prison . Avoid Russia!
reviews.author: Ul D

reviews.title: Last time we choose to fly with Ural Airlines
reviews.text: Our flight was scheduled to take off regularly at 03:05. We checked on the status of the flight at 11pm and found out that there is a delay of 3 hours, not a sigle notification came from the airlines, furthermore, as the company does not have possibility for online registration we had to arrive 5 hours ealier our flight to check in, otherwise the company would close the check in as regular. After 5 hours of exhausting waiting at night in the airport, we finally boarded. Because of such delay we lost our ticket to Voronej and had to wait 9 hours for the next flight. My anger towards the company increased at the baggage claim, where I found out that my baggage that travelled 13 countries with me, was broken and one of the wheels was missing🤦🏻‍♀️. I decided for myself, this was my last time flying with Ural airlines.
reviews.author: Astghik B

reviews.title: Refund
reviews.text: Flight got cancelled due to Covid, logged in a ticket for refund, agent got back to me within 24 hours and received back a full refund in less then a week.
reviews.author: Mihaela P

reviews.title: Don’t fly with UralAirlines! Service is horrible
reviews.text: Flight in less than 12 hours before departure was canceled and changed to an other city, flight was delayed by 10 hours with false reason. They were telling frustrated passengers that UAE airport didn’t give them landing permission, in fact, I called to Ras Al Khaimah airport and learned that permission was given for that particular flight U6-7103. So representative just gave excuses to keep passengers quiet You can’t even reach out by calling their hotline operator, the line always was busy and flight representative was completely unhelpful and rude to upset passengers.
reviews.author: Jam M

reviews.title: Well, I did it again
reviews.text: On my last review I told that I would never step foot on this airline again. Well during these times, you sometimes don't have a choice. I really didn't want to fly the airline that I wouldn't bet can successfully manage lemonade stand, but well, here we go... So, this flight was short, so I don't know if they still feed the passengers with bread and cucmber. Anyway, when I brought the tickets, I got a list of additional services i can purchase. One of them blew my mind, they asked me to pay them a fee (like, insurance), so in case they go bankrupt they will return me all the money I spent on a ticket. Hello? Are you alright there? You WILL return every cent to every passenger in any case where you will cancel the flight, don't make any mistakes about it. That IS a SCAM. Also couple of days before the flight I got an email from them saying that they can help me with registration on a flight. And yeah, they asked for $20 to do it. $20 so they could do couple of clicks and send you boarding pass via email. And my favorite, seat selection, no matter what seat you choose - you pay. But if you skip it, you will get nice seats anyway with someone you're flying with (yeah, I will talk about this issue on another airline). To sum it up - This airline doesn't care about the passengers. See what I wrote about registration process. Instead of helping people to register online or encourage them to do so, so there would be less people standing in line in the airport (ESPECIALLY now), they just want to grab your money, that's it. Greedy, money-hungry, corporate scam business. The one-star rating stays, as I don't see any improvements
reviews.author: Boris

reviews.title: amazing service... even though i wan entitled to it
reviews.text: Was supposed to fly with them to st petersburg from moscow... but couldnt get to russia because of lockdown ( not even their problem ) , flight obviously as on schedule and i just sent email literally a week after the flight took place.. , a month later had a voucher issued valid for 3 years for full amount... tbh wasnt expecting anything... and still waiting on aeroflot....
reviews.author: alexred

reviews.title: Please don’t use Ural Airlines
reviews.text: I strongly recommend you not to use Russian Ural Airlines for any trips in Russia. This is the most unprofessional company with poor staff without any communication skills and lack of any support, even just recommendations. Take Aeroflot instead and please ignore Ural airlines
reviews.author: Julia T

reviews.title: NO TICKET REFUND
reviews.text: Got my ticket with a refund option to Chelyabinsk on Apr 21 but had to cancel the trip due to the virus lockdown. The call-center lady said refund was available upon request on the website which I did right after. Now it's been almost 3 months and there's no refund nor there are any news from the company. Think twice guys. Booking no NKNT2P Ticket number 2622474121072
reviews.author: Dan A

reviews.title: Handling of COVID19
reviews.text: My flight were cancelled due to epidemic. On the website they tell to get a refund - submit online feedback form. After 3 weeks of waiting got a reply to fill their paper form and send the claim for a refund to their office in Ekaterinburg. They said review will take up to 90 days. It will be “fun” doing this from UK.
reviews.author: Andrey K

reviews.title: This airline will always left you alone with your problems
reviews.text: I have never met this kind of "service", or better to say, no service at all. I cancelled my trip from Germany to Russia. Lufthansa has reimbursed full cost for unused tickets and even returned miles to my account. S7 offered certificates with 10% extra for future tickets (not perfect, but at least something). Only Ural Airlines did not give a s..t to its customers. Just imagine! They deleted the button "Ticket return" from the their website. When one try to call in, the line is ALWAYS overloaded. Online consultant is not available at all! No any other options to cancel the flight! I would strongly recommend not to use this company.
reviews.author: Andrey

reviews.title: Recommend instead of BA and Aeroflot.
reviews.text: Very easy, fast, cheap and good quality way to travel from UK to Russia. The service is great! Flexible tariffs and availability.
reviews.author: kate N

reviews.title: Did the job done
reviews.text: I didn't expected much, so it was a surprise in a good way. The plane was relatively clean and departed and arrived on time. The staff didn't speak much English, which very common in Russia, but strange for an international airline company.
reviews.author: Nasuella

reviews.title: Will never fly with this airlines again
reviews.text: Apart from that everything was dirty and there was a delay, the pilots couldn’t land the plane after the 1st try (when the plane was only a few meters above the ground). The plane raised into the air again and was flying around for like 40 minutes. I understand that this might be a normal practice and there can be 1000 little reasons for this, BUT there was absolutely 0 information, 0 comunication from the crew and the captain, while the people were panicking at the same time ! We landed horribly afterwards and everyone was stressed.
reviews.author: Edik H

reviews.title: mid-level lowcoster
reviews.text: This is ordinary low-coster: no service, but no terrestrials... Crew staff is not friendly, but not rudy
reviews.author: Daemon-FF

reviews.title: Terrible service and rude staff
reviews.text: Flight attendats don´t speak english and they are rude, when you try to speak english with them. Also staff in the office of Ural Airlines on Zhukovo international airport didn´t speak english. It was second flight with them and second time the same problem.
reviews.author: Felipe

reviews.title: Exactly on schedule
reviews.text: Boarding and baggage handling were absolutely fine. Both forth and back flights started exactly on time. The on-board service was good enough as well as the economy class fly comfort.
reviews.author: Mikhail R

reviews.title: HORRIBLE DELAYS! Stay away
reviews.text: Apart from the heroism of the pilots who'd recently safely landed this company's aircraft on a corn field saving everyone - the management of this airline SUCKS BIG TIME. There was hardly a flight without a significant delay in the entire months of August and September 2019. I was green enough to buy a ticket with this airline, I was on a tight schedule - and I was absolutely terrified when I arrived at the airport around midnight and found out my flight is delayed by FOUR AND A HALF HOURS. Good luck finding another flight at peak season, and in the middle of the night. They did refund my money, since I at least bought a policy with delay protection - but again, much later, after I had to go to a physical airport register, then send the paper they gave me, to some email address, then waiting for a week... But just think: would you need any of this on vacation???
reviews.author: M Y

reviews.title: Никому не рекомендую – Won’t recommend to anyone
reviews.text: (English below) Рейсы данной компании задерживаются планомерно уже с августа (слова официального представителя). Время вылета нашего рейса менялось уже 4 раза (и это мы еще не улетели на момент написания данного отзыва). И если сначала приходили смс-уведомления, то о последнем изменении мы узнали уже в аэропорту. Мы должны были вылететь в 23:50, в итоге рейс задержали до 4:45 (!), а сейчас уже до 5:15. Хорошо, что в Домодедово есть Экспресс отель прямо в самом здании Терминала 1 с почасовой оплатой... Вывод – не собираюсь больше связываться с данной авиакомпанией. И вам на советую! Flights of this company have been systematically delayed since August (words from an official representative). The departure time of our flight has already changed 4 times (and we have not left it at the time of writing this review). And if at first you may receive SMS notifications, later we learned about the latest change only at the airport. We were supposed to fly out at 23:50, as a result, the flight was delayed until 4:45 (!) and now it is already delayed until 5:15. It’s good that Domodedovo has an Express Hotel right in the building of Terminal 1 with an hourly fee... Conclusion - I’m not going to get in touch with this airline anymore. And I highly recommend all of you this as well!
reviews.author: Polina

reviews.title: Beware of Visa requirements !
reviews.text: I have to say this was a terrible and expensive mistake to buy a ticket for Ural airlines from cheapoair that has to transfer in Zhukovsky airport as it requires a Visa for Russia just to be a transit passenger. We were told there was also a 1000 Euro fine for not having a Visa upon arrival at this airport. There was no warning about Visa requirements when booking this flight, so beware.
reviews.author: MONSREVIEW

reviews.title: If you care about your safety time and money avoid Ural Airlines
reviews.text: This is third attemp to fly Ural Airlines and the last one. Each attempt was ar least four hours late. One was delayed because if technical problems during landing and they were keeping in the secret while it was already on TV.. Resuming: - old aircrafts approx 12-18 years old - when you have delay noone will take care, noone will update the information or status. - you will not be able to reach call center and even if you reach will tell you nothing. I believe soon they will loose the license and stop any activities. The pictures tell you more
reviews.author: ABH

reviews.title: Ok flight not very worth the price
reviews.text: 3h20 min flight but no food or entertainment, average legroom and service. I was nervous about this airlines but they get the job done.
reviews.author: Arijit Datta

reviews.title: Very good airline company but with delays
reviews.text: Everything was good except the delay in the DME airport. Also it was impossible to do electronic registration.
reviews.author: ybeloglazov

reviews.title: Long delay, no warning, and terrible service
reviews.text: When an airline knows it isn’t going to be delayed hours in advanced, it is common curtesy to issue a text message and/or email. This didn’t not happen with Ural Airlines answer we ended up waiting in the airport for more than five hours. Furthermore, beside repeating the official story/excuse that the “wrong plane” took off with fewer seats than needed for the back and forth journeys it would be making, no other information, help, or services were offered. We were ignored by two check-in staffers and sent to a third who told us to return in an hour in case he could put us on a flight scheduled for our original departure time. We came back an hour later and he completely ignored everyone (six people) who he hadn’t told that story told to, and then refused to speak to any of us anymore and disappearing. Our “consolation” for the delay was officially “a bottle of water” but even that they didn’t have in the canteen they indicated. I chose the flight because they had the flight times that best fit my work schedule, and now my work day is ruined. To say I am disappointed in not getting the service I paid for is an understatement.
reviews.author: JTill

reviews.title: The worst customer service ever!
reviews.text: The worst customer service I've ever encountered. They pretend they don't recognize screenshots of their own website, they try to charge you extra for services they claim are for free, and after a week of exchanging emails, they eventually deleted my conversation and ignored my request for a vegetarian menu. 3 out of 4 of my flights were delayed, of course no chance for compensation. In addition to that, only one toilet was available for the whole plane (over 230 passengers!). Very unfriendly and nasty flight attendants, who don't even bother to speak English. Not recommended at all!
reviews.author: Aleks D

reviews.title: Hands Off from this banana Airline
reviews.text: Worst experience ever refused boarding missed a business meeting in Kasachstan very unfriendly never fly with this airline again
reviews.author: derebaba

reviews.title: No food in economy, bare-bone ZIA airport
reviews.text: The recently opened airport offered very basic services; the flight was delayed by 90 minutes, however, all the apologies were offered, and the personnel was attentive and energetic during the flight. No food or drinks were offered in economy, just water, which was a bit taxing since the flight lasted 4 hours.
reviews.author: Vince M

reviews.title: WORLD'S WORST AIRLINES
reviews.text: We were flying from Moscow to St Petersburg on Sept 2, 2019. The flight was 12 hours late. The morning 10 am flight reached St Petersburg at 11.30 pm. There was no explanation given for flight delay, no apology from Ural Airlines. We were not even given water. Shame! on such Airlines. I had a small baby with me. I faced so much trouble, can't tell. NEVER travel in Ural Airlines. Horrible!
reviews.author: Chandana Roy

reviews.title: Pay extra or seat separately and there will be no food anyway
reviews.text: The company charges for everything and has some strange rules. Online registration is abscent and we understood why when we came to the airport: we were told directly that if we want to sit together with my husband we have to pay for seats - prices started from 8 $ per seat. Otherwise they would seat us separately. Well we paid, it's not so much. But on our way back the transfer bus brought us to the airport a bit late and we were among the last people for registration. We were told (ATTENTION!) that there wasn't any seats left so we will sit separately. Well ok, it happens. But imagine my surprise when the boarding was complete and there were THREE empty seats next to me :) I asked very nicely if my husband could seat with me and my request was denied because those seats were extra charge. BUT! I was seated there for free as well as the couple across the way. Because the plane didn't have enough free seats or something. I suggested we could pay, it wasn't a problem. But they said it was possible only during registration where, i'd like to remind you, they didn't offer us such a choice! THey said "there aren't free seats". Direct misinformation. That was really unpleasant and dissapointing. Also there is not much leg space. And another important thing: our flight was more than 3 hours but there was no food :) Be ready, take your own snacks with you. Anyway it's good enough for those prices if you need to get somewhere not far and are ready to pay extra and be hungry :) But if you need to fly some significant distance or want some respect and comfort - that is not a choice for you.
reviews.author: vdmitrevskaya

reviews.title: The Worlds Worst Airline
reviews.text: Honestly, this is the Worst Airline in the World. Our flight was shown as being 3 hours late, but in fact took off 4 hours late - with no apology and no explaination. We, and other passengers, were told that if we wanted to ask for compensation we had to write a recorded delivery letter to the Chairman of the Company - but we were not even given the information as to where or who to send that to.....! The "business class" service is worse than dreadful. No extra legroom, "food" that is virtually inedible, (dry, over salted and just not at all nice) and not even an alcoholic drink to take away from the awfulness. Expensive and just awful - I BEG YOU - do NOT under any circumstances travel with this terrible airline. Honestly - Walk instead, it will be more pleasant.
reviews.author: Archie D

reviews.title: Very Average Flight
reviews.text: Short 1h 15m flight. No food/snack service. No beverage service. Buy something at the airport if you need to. Very good economy legroom.
reviews.author: TravelinAlan

reviews.title: Worst flight ever
reviews.text: Plane was late for 6 hours for no reason and lost my luggage and received after 7 days of my arrival. And below situation inside the plane. Never fly with Ural airlines. Plane was insanely dirty and staffs were very unprofessional. You can see the attached picture of flight attendant, she doesn’t even fit plane. I asked blanket 3 times, they didn’t even responded. I waited them to bring, but their response was they don’t have blankets in the plane. When I was getting off the plane, I saw they had blankets in the entertainment. I was so much offended. Please, never fly with them if you respect yourself. Peace!
reviews.author: TezWiFi

reviews.title: Average service for a Russian airline, but costly.
reviews.text: This review is for a leg of travel in a 3 leg trip. This only pertains to the Ural Airlines portion of the flight, going from Moscow to Simferopol. Ural is not what I would call a terrible airline - they fly relatively new Airbus planes that are clean and the food is good. What really stinks about Ural is their customer service. When we were checking in for out flight, after arrival at DME from Frankfurt, they informed us we had to pay $200 per bag for our luggage, as our ticket only allowed a 10kg carry on. Normally, airlines go by the baggage limits of the "predominate" airline of a multi-segment trip, which in our case was Condor which allowed one bag and checked 2 for us without cost. There was no arguing with them. They would not take cash, nor would they take an American Visa card. We had to call a relative that lived in Moscow to come and pay for us using a Russian Visa card. Very inconvenient, and ruined the entire trip. We were told the plane would board "20 minutes late", which is fact turned out to be over an hour late. We arrived at the SIP airport a full hour late. This is not our first experience with Ural and their late flights. This is mainly due to the fact that they fly the same plane between DME and SIP round trip, multiple times per day. If the plane coming in is late for any reason, your flight is delayed... which delays their next flight, and the next, and ... you get the point.
reviews.author: Kevin M

reviews.title: nice nonstop flight to Yekaterinburg
reviews.text: Ural staff at Prague airport very helpful.excellent stewart on plane with help for back problems I was having from fractured L!
reviews.author: blkptds

reviews.title: Dont do that!!!!
reviews.text: Omg 5 hrs flight with about 20 cm leg room 2 small sandwiches for 5 hours its just a joke Bad aircraft and took of 50 min late after we were already on the plane. Dont do that to yourself!!! Very not nice experience
reviews.author: Sima Robsky

reviews.title: Horrible experience, Nobody speaks anything but Russian
reviews.text: Horrible. 1. Airconditioner was not working. 2. They server you only a small sandwich for a 5 hours flight and there is only Tea. No Coffee!! 3. Nobody spoke English nor Spanish. Even the emergency instructions, all in Russian. 4. there was 2 hours delay to take off. I took 2 flights and both were the same.
reviews.author: Mohamedaboud

reviews.title: WORST AIR COMPANY EVER
reviews.text: I always thought that you can't go worse than Aeroflot. Oh was I wrong. Aeroflot are kings compared to Ural Airlines. Let's start from the food, let's say you need special meal for some reasons (like medical), you enter their web site find the option to change the meal and what do you see - you need to pay extra for it. Ok, so I didn't order extra meal in the end, but what did they get me as regular meal? 2 sandwiches (bread + cucumber). 2 sandwiches on a 5 hour flight. Is this a joke? Then flight attendance went through the plane and sell extra food. By the time she got to me, she was almost empty. And the best part is - it's not cheap, costs exactly like other companies. So, never again, I will step foot in the planes of Ural Airlines. This company should be closed as soon as possible.
reviews.author: Boris

reviews.title: Very simple
reviews.text: Half an hour delay for embarcation, it is not too much, but we hade to wait the taking off about an hour inside the aircraft. It was known in advance by avia company,but time-table was not corrected. The aircraft inside was very old and waited renovation. Service was too much simple, only water, tea and bread with chease and ham.The flight lasted 4 hours. The landing was very good inspite of the rainy and windy weather. Luggage was delivered in time.
reviews.author: Svetlana_Jam

reviews.title: No service at all
reviews.text: Terrible airlines.I did not have such bad experience in my life. Buying round trip ticket online from Ural Airlines website they have an option of extra baggage.We bought one. Flying from Tbilisi to Sochi, they hardly found it and wanted us to pay for overweight. On the way back from Sochi, they did not find it and in a rude way told us to go to the representatives of Ural Airlines inside airport and find baggage there. Ok, so we went, there was nobody at the desk, for more than 30 min. Can you imagine it??? we have to pass registration but nobody comes to check the problem!!!!!
